Once the thought comes, it sticks. I go over the same scenarios again and again—what tests they’d do, how they might have missed something in my last blood work, what my scan would show. Even when I tell myself it’s irrational, the images and “what ifs” keep looping.

Because of my nursing background, I find myself checking my body over and over—feeling for lumps, taking my temperature several times a day, re-reading lab reports, Googling symptoms late into the night. I keep asking my GP to recheck things, even when the last results were normal. I know it’s excessive and it’s taking up hours of my day, but I feel compelled to do it until the anxiety eases a bit, at least for a little while.
